**Build is green now.** Exit code 0, no errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link step:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. It now takes either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was unset. Unset now means off, like before.

All 8 warnings are still printed. `build.js` holds them as fixed text. They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, which your project does not have. Only editing `build.js` would hide them.
